[1/1] Allow out-of-order Cadet Flight Academy milestone completion and thread graduation relics across all tutorial actions

impact_assessment.why: Previously _progress_tutorial only checked cur.steps[cur.current_step_index], so beginners who traded, scanned, routed power, or bought a drone at the starting Citadel station before orbiting sol_body_1 received no credit and were later stranded away from a station on step 4
impact_assessment.benefits: Beginners can complete Cadet Flight Academy milestones in any natural order without losing rewards or getting stranded, while sequential 0..5 play remains identical
impact_assessment.risks: contract: existing sequential tutorial tests check current_step_index; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: graduating on a non-jump step must still award relic_cadet_wings and +15 max_hull
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep current_step_index pointed at the first remaining uncompleted step (or len(steps) on graduation) and apply _apply_relic_stat_bonuses for tut_relics across orbit, power, trade, drone, and tick arrival

[1/1] Add GUIDE ME button on Cadet Academy banner and collapse advanced sub-panels in Commerce, Fleet, Ship, and Story tabs by default

impact_assessment.why: Beginners face tall scrolling panels in Commerce, Fleet, Ship, and Story with advanced sub-mechanics expanded by default, and the Cadet Academy banner lacked a one-click control to navigate to or auto-dock for the active step
impact_assessment.benefits: Default Commerce, Fleet, Ship, and Story tabs fit cleanly at 1280x720 without scrolling, and clicking GUIDE ME on the Cadet Academy banner positions the ship and opens the exact UI control for the current step
impact_assessment.risks: contract: existing UI inventory and layout tests check DOM IDs and disclosure selectors; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: hidden disclosures must remain expandable via their SHOW/HIDE toggles
impact_assessment.mitigation: Preserve all DOM IDs and CSS selector substrings, use standard applyDisclosure wiring, and verify in real Edge via G-015 visual inspection
